paper_title: Long-baseline quantum sensor network as dark matter haloscope
suggested_experiment_name: AMAILS (Atomic Magnetometer Arrays in Large Shields, Suzhou-Harbin network)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: AMAILS: network of 15 atomic magnetometers in two shielded rooms (Harbin/Suzhou) searching for dark photon dark matter via kinetic mixing over mass range 4.1 feV - 2.1 peV. Only one explicit numerical value given in text: epsilon ~5e-6 at 2.1 peV (2.1e-12 eV). Low-mass endpoint estimated from B ∝ epsilon·m scaling (Eq.1) giving ~worse limit at lower mass; the plotted curve (Fig 3b) not numerically available. DM density stated as 0.45 GeV/cm^3. 95% C.L. Values approximate; endpoints reflect text-quoted best limit and scaling-inferred low-mass value. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 31)) | Vision: Figure 3b of arXiv:2305.00890.
